summary: UI text-layout helper on the UITextRenderWithScale (004D7E40) path. Resolves a per-owner object via SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(a4), and only when non-null measures the text through sub_5531F0 into a4 (and re-derived a1), then stores the horizontally centered position a2 - a4/2 into *a3 and returns a3. When the lookup fails it returns the null lookup result and leaves a3 untouched.

local_names.a1: render/anchor context passed to the measuring helper
local_names.a2: available extent (e.g. container width) used as the centering base
local_names.a3: output pointer receiving the centered position
local_names.a4: lookup key; after the measuring call holds the measured text size

operations.description: Resolve the owner object by key a4 through SwitchBasedGlobalLookup; the non-null result gates the whole body
If the global lookup returned null, skip the body and return that null result directly
Measure text metrics for context a1, writing the measured size back through &a4 and the re-derived context through &a1, with a 0 flag
Centered offset: a4 / 2 yields half the measured size, then *a3 = a2 - (a4 / 2)
Store the computed centered position into the output slot *a3
Return a3 (the output slot pointer) so the caller can chain on the stored value
Invoked from UITextRenderWithScale (004D7E40) as part of scaled text layout

unresolved: The exact meaning of a1 and the third argument (address-of a1) inside sub_5531F0 is not verifiable from this function alone; a4 is reused as both the lookup key and the measured size output
The units of a2 and a4 (pixels vs scaled units) depend on the UI scaling context of UITextRenderWithScale and are not established here
